infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Shipping Wish requires camera access to scan and upload signed Bill of Lading (BOL), Proof of Delivery (POD), and scale tickets.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Shipping Wish requires photo library access to attach freight documents and inspection photos.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Shipping Wish uses your location for real-time load tracking, ELD compliance, and automated detention check-in.
